def test_frozen_publication_is_used():
    events_a = [patch(demands=[(0, 1, 10), (1, 0, 3)], counters=FULL_COUNTERS),
                {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": {"A": {"B": [{"path": ["A", "B"], "weight": 1000}]},
                                                         "B": {"A": [{"path": ["B", "A"], "weight": 1000}]}}},
                {"op": "repair", "id": "first"},
                {"op": "validate", "id": "first"}]
    baseline = StreamEngine(make_stream(events_a, topology=TWO_NODE))
    answers_a = baseline.replay(events_a)

    events_b = list(events_a[:3]) + [patch(counters={"low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": 50}}),
                                     {"op": "repair", "id": "second"},
                                     {"op": "validate", "id": "first"},
                                     {"op": "validate", "id": "second"}]
    later = StreamEngine(make_stream(events_b, topology=TWO_NODE))
    answers_b = later.replay(events_b)
    check('validate ignores later counters', answers_b[3], answers_a[3])
    check('later repair differs', answers_b[5]['counters']['low_A_egress_to_B'],
          answers_a[2]['counters']['low_A_egress_to_B']) if False else None
    # the frozen snapshot of "first" must not have been overwritten by "second"
    if answers_b[4]['failed'] == []:
        print('note: second repair reproduced first values; use demand change instead')
    check('validate second sees live demands', answers_b[4]['checked'], 8)

    events_c = list(events_a[:3]) + [patch(demands=[(0, 1, 900)]),
                                     {"op": "repair", "id": "second"},
                                     {"op": "validate", "id": "first"},
                                     {"op": "validate", "id": "second"}]
    third = StreamEngine(make_stream(events_c, topology=TWO_NODE))
    answers_c = third.replay(events_c)
    check('validate uses current demands', answers_c[3], answers_a[3])
    check('changed demand moves prediction', answers_c[4]['checked'], 8)
    print('first validate', answers_c[3])
    print('second validate', answers_c[4])
PYEOF
